description: Calls the HTTP API of a third party that the organization declared as a connection (its name and domain: list_connections), on its base address, within its rules and limits; while adds the authentication and keeps a record of the call.

body.description: Request body: an object (sent as JSON) or text.

call.description: Id of a held call: its state and, once run, its result.

path.description: Path at the provider, with its query string: /api/v1/slots?site=origines.

type.description: Type of the body (Content-Type), if it is not JSON.

name: call_connection
title: Call a connection's API
